"""Parse cost types and key figures per Produktgruppe from an Einzelplan PDF. For every Produktgruppe the Einzelplan volume has an "Ergebnisplan der Produktgruppe" (costs by type, Tsd. EUR, 2024-2030 including the updated plan 2026) and usually a table "Kennzahlen der Produktgruppe" (key figures such as numbers of students). The Einzelplan of each Produktgruppe comes from the page header ("Einzelplan 3.1 ..."), so one volume may cover several Einzelpläne. Usage: python3 -I scripts/parse_epl.py """ import json import os import re import subprocess import sys YEARS = ["2024", "2025", "2026", "2027", "2028", "2029", "2030"] NUM_RE = re.compile(r"(?[\d.]+ Ergebnisplan der Produktgruppe (\d{3}\.\d{2}) (.*?)") KZ_RE = re.compile(r"
[\d.]+ Kennzahlen der Produktgruppe (\d{3}\.\d{2})") MAIN_RE = re.compile(r"^\s*(\d{1,2})\.\s+(\S.*?)\s*$") SUB_RE = re.compile(r"^\s*([a-e])\)\s+(\S.*?)\s*$") KZ_ROW_RE = re.compile(r"^(\s*)([A-Z]_\d{3}_\d{2}_\d{3})\s+(.*)$") HEAD_RE = re.compile(r"Ist 2024|Ist 2025|Fortg\. Plan|Plan 2027|Plan 2028|Plan 2029|Plan 2030") # Row labels of the standard Ergebnisplan, keyed by position. LABELS = { "1": "Erlöse", "2": "Kosten aus laufender Verwaltungstätigkeit", "2a": "davon Mieten, Pachten und Erbbauzinsen", "2b": "davon IT-Kosten", "2c": "davon Prüfung, Beratung, Rechtsschutz", "3": "Personalkosten", "3a": "Entgelte", "3b": "Bezüge", "3c": "Sonstige Kosten mit Entgelt- oder Bezugscharakter", "3d": "Sozialleistungen", "3e": "Versorgungsleistungen", "4": "Kosten aus Transferleistungen", "5": "Kosten aus Abschreibungen", "6": "Sonstige Kosten", "7": "Ergebnis der laufenden Verwaltungstätigkeit", "8": "Erlöse des Finanzergebnisses", "9": "Kosten des Finanzergebnisses", "10": "Finanzergebnis", "11": "Jahresergebnis", "12": "Globale Mehrkosten", "13": "Globale Minderkosten", "14": "Jahresergebnis einschließlich globaler Mehr- und Minderkosten", } def pages(pdf): out = subprocess.run(["pdftotext", "-layout", pdf, "-"], check=True, capture_output=True) return out.stdout.decode("utf-8").split("\f") def number(tok): return float(tok.replace(".", "").replace(",", ".")) def header_centers(lines): """Return the centre of each year header cell, or None.""" for line in lines: hits = list(HEAD_RE.finditer(line)) if len(hits) == 7: return [(m.start() + m.end()) / 2 for m in hits] return None def values(line, start, centers): """Assign the numbers right of `start` to the nearest year column.""" vals = [None] * len(centers) for m in NUM_RE.finditer(line, start): mid = (m.start() + m.end()) / 2 idx = min(range(len(centers)), key=lambda i: abs(mid - centers[i])) if vals[idx] is not None: raise ValueError(f"column {YEARS[idx]} assigned twice: {line!r}") vals[idx] = number(m.group()) return vals def label_end(line): """Index after the label text: the first number preceded by two spaces.""" m = re.search(r"\S\s{2,}-?\d", line) return m.start() + 1 if m else len(line) def parse_ergebnisplan(text): lines = text.splitlines() centers = header_centers(lines) if not centers: return None rows, main = {}, None for line in lines: cut = label_end(line) label = line[:cut] m, s = MAIN_RE.match(label), SUB_RE.match(label) if m and m.group(1) in LABELS: main = m.group(1) key = main elif s and main in ("2", "3"): key = main + s.group(1) else: continue if key in rows: continue rows[key] = values(line, cut, centers) if key == "14": break return rows def parse_kennzahlen(text): lines = text.splitlines() centers = header_centers(lines) if not centers: return [] out, cur = [], None for line in lines: m = KZ_ROW_RE.match(line) if m: rest = m.group(3) # Name and unit are separated from the numbers by two or more spaces. parts = re.split(r"\s{2,}", rest.strip()) name = parts[0] unit = parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 and not NUM_RE.fullmatch(parts[1]) else "" start = line.index(unit, len(m.group(1)) + len(m.group(2)) + len(name)) + len(unit) if unit else len(m.group(1)) + len(m.group(2)) + 1 + len(name) cur = {"code": m.group(2), "name": name, "einheit": unit, "indent": len(m.group(1)), **dict(zip(YEARS, values(line, start, centers)))} out.append(cur) elif cur and line.strip() and not NUM_RE.search(line) and len(line) - len(line.lstrip()) >= cur["indent"] - 2: cur["name"] += " " + line.strip() else: cur = None for k in out: k.pop("indent") k["name"] = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", k["name"]).replace("- ", "-") if k["name"].endswith("-") else re.sub(r"\s+", " ", k["name"]) return out PROD_RE = re.compile(r"^\s*(\S.*?)\s{2,}(\d{3}|INT)\s*$") KE_RE = re.compile(r"^\s*(Erlöse|Kosten)(?=\s|$)") SALDO_RE = re.compile(r"^\s*Saldo Jahresergebnis ([12])") END_RE = re.compile(r"
[\d.]+ (?!Kosten und Erlöse)") def parse_produkte(texts): """Parse 'Kosten und Erlöse der Produktgruppe' over one or more pages. Per product: e1/k1 = revenue and costs of Jahresergebnis 1 (direct), e2/k2 = revenue and costs added in Jahresergebnis 2 (allocation of the authority's internal services). """ out, cur, stage, centers = [], None, 0, None for text in texts: for line in text.splitlines(): if END_RE.search(line): return out c = header_centers([line]) if c: centers = c continue if centers is None: continue s = SALDO_RE.match(line) if s: stage = 2 if s.group(1) == "1" else 0 continue k = KE_RE.match(line) if k and cur is not None and stage: key = ("e" if k.group(1) == "Erlöse" else "k") + str(stage) cur[key] = values(line, k.end(), centers) continue p = PROD_RE.match(line) if p and not NUM_RE.search(p.group(1)): cur = {"produkt": p.group(1).strip(), "ipr": p.group(2)} out.append(cur) stage = 1 return out PAGE_EPL_RE = re.compile(r"Einzelplan\s+(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s") def page_epl(text): """Return the Einzelplan code from the page header, or None.""" for line in text.splitlines()[:6]: m = PAGE_EPL_RE.search(line) if m: return m.group(1) return None def main(pdf, out_path): pg_pages = pages(pdf) result = {"quelle": os.path.basename(pdf), "produktgruppen": []} for i, text in enumerate(pg_pages): for m in ERG_RE.finditer(text): pg, name = m.group(1), m.group(2).strip() rows = parse_ergebnisplan(text[m.end():]) or None nxt = pg_pages[i + 1] if i + 1 < len(pg_pages) else "" if rows is None and "
" not in nxt.split("Tsd. EUR")[0]: # The table starts on the next page when the heading sits at the bottom. rows = parse_ergebnisplan(nxt) or None produkte = [] # The product table and key figures follow before the next Produktgruppe. stop = next((j for j in range(i + 1, len(pg_pages)) if ERG_RE.search(pg_pages[j])), len(pg_pages)) for j in range(i, stop): h = re.search(r"
[\d.]+ Kosten und Erlöse der Produktgruppe " + re.escape(pg), pg_pages[j]) if h: produkte = parse_produkte([pg_pages[j][h.end():], *pg_pages[j + 1:j + 8]]) break kz = [] for j in range(i, stop): k = KZ_RE.search(pg_pages[j]) if k and k.group(1) == pg: kz = parse_kennzahlen(pg_pages[j][k.end():]) break result["produktgruppen"].append({"epl": page_epl(text), "pg": pg, "name": name, "seite": i + 1, "ergebnisplan": rows, "produkte": produkte, "kennzahlen": kz}) with open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(result, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1) print(f"{out_path}: {len(result['produktgruppen'])} Produktgruppen") if __name__ == "__main__": main(*sys.argv[1:3])

"""Write the dashboard's data files ({rows, meta}) from data/site.json.

Usage: .venv/bin/python -I scripts/export_dashboard.py <site.json> <out_dir>
"""

import json
import os
import sys

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))


def code(name):
    with open(os.path.join(HERE, name), encoding="utf-8") as f:
        return {"label": name, "value": f.read(), "type": "code", "lang": "python"}


SOURCE_PDF = {"label": "Quelle", "value": "Haushaltsplan-Entwurf 2027/2028, Band Gesamthaushalt (PDF, Finanzbehörde Hamburg, Juli 2026)"}


def write(out_dir, name, rows, meta):
    path = os.path.join(out_dir, name)
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump({"rows": rows, "meta": meta}, f, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))
    print(f"{path}: {len(rows)} Zeilen, {os.path.getsize(path) / 1024:.0f} KB")


IST = ("24", "25")
PLAN = ("27", "28", "29", "30")


def has(p, years):
    return any(p[f"{a}{y}"] for a in ("k", "e") for y in years)


def name_key(s):
    return "".join(ch for ch in s.lower() if ch.isalnum())


def link_moved_products(prod):
    """Map the actuals of products that moved to a new row onto that row.

    A product that changes its Einzelplan or name for the 2027 plan appears twice in the
    IPR report: the old row carries only actuals (2024, 2025), the new row only plan values.
    Adds vk24, vk25, ve24, ve25 = actuals in the structure of the 2027 plan, plus wechsel
    ('zugang' | 'abgang' | '') and wechsel_text.
    """
    from difflib import SequenceMatcher

    for p in prod:
        for a in ("k", "e"):
            for y in IST:
                p[f"v{a}{y}"] = p[f"{a}{y}"]
        p["wechsel"], p["wechsel_text"], p["wechsel_extern"] = "", "", False

    pre = [p for p in prod if has(p, IST) and not has(p, PLAN)]
    suc = [p for p in prod if has(p, PLAN) and not has(p, IST)]
    # Pass 1: same IPR number and same name. Several old and new rows may share one group,
    # for example a transfer payment that moves from the district offices to one authority.
    groups = {}
    for s in suc:
        olds = [p for p in pre if p["ipr"] == s["ipr"] and name_key(p["produkt"]) == name_key(s["produkt"])]
        if olds:
            g = groups.setdefault((s["ipr"], name_key(s["produkt"])), (set(), []))
            g[0].update(p["id"] for p in olds)
            g[1].append(s)
    # Pass 2: same IPR number and a near-identical name, one new row per old row.
    used_pre = {i for g in groups.values() for i in g[0]}
    used_suc = {s["id"] for g in groups.values() for s in g[1]}
    for s in suc:
        if s["id"] in used_suc:
            continue
        cands = [(SequenceMatcher(None, name_key(p["produkt"]), name_key(s["produkt"])).ratio(), p)
                 for p in pre if p["id"] not in used_pre and p["ipr"] == s["ipr"]]
        cands = [c for c in cands if c[0] >= 0.9]
        if cands:
            p = max(cands, key=lambda c: c[0])[1]
            used_pre.add(p["id"])
            groups[("fuzzy", s["id"])] = ({p["id"]}, [s])

    by_id = {p["id"]: p for p in prod}
    for pre_ids, sucs in groups.values():
        olds = [by_id[i] for i in sorted(pre_ids, key=int)]
        weights = [max(s["k27"], 0) or max(s["e27"], 0) for s in sucs]
        total = sum(weights) or len(sucs)
        weights = [w / total if sum(weights) else 1 / len(sucs) for w in weights]
        for s, w in zip(sucs, weights):
            for a in ("k", "e"):
                for y in IST:
                    s[f"v{a}{y}"] = round(sum(o[f"{a}{y}"] for o in olds) * w, 1)
            s["wechsel"] = "zugang"
            s["wechsel_extern"] = any(o["epl"] != s["epl"] for o in olds)
            s["wechsel_text"] = describe_origin(s, olds, len(sucs) > 1)
        for o in olds:
            for a in ("k", "e"):
                for y in IST:
                    o[f"v{a}{y}"] = 0
            o["wechsel"] = "abgang"
            o["wechsel_extern"] = any(x["epl"] != o["epl"] for x in sucs)
            o["wechsel_text"] = describe_target(o, sucs)
    moved = sum(len(g[0]) for g in groups.values())
    print(f"verschobene Produkte: {moved} alte Zeilen, {sum(len(g[1]) for g in groups.values())} neue Zeilen")


def plans(rows):
    names = sorted({r["epl_kurz"] for r in rows})
    return f"im Einzelplan {names[0]}" if len(names) == 1 else "in den Einzelplänen " + ", ".join(names)


def describe_origin(s, olds, split):
    o = olds[0]
    if len(olds) == 1 and o["epl"] == s["epl"] and name_key(o["produkt"]) == name_key(s["produkt"]):
        src = f"der früheren Produktgruppe „{o['pg_name']}“"
    elif len(olds) == 1 and o["epl"] == s["epl"]:
        src = f"dem früheren Produkt „{o['produkt']}“"
    elif len(olds) == 1:
        src = f"dem Produkt „{o['produkt']}“ {plans(olds)}"
    else:
        src = f"{len(olds)} Produkten {plans(olds)}"
    tail = ", anteilig nach den Kosten 2027" if split else ""
    return f"Das Ist 2024 und 2025 stammt aus {src}{tail}."


def describe_target(o, sucs):
    s = sucs[0]
    if len(sucs) == 1 and s["epl"] == o["epl"] and name_key(o["produkt"]) == name_key(s["produkt"]):
        return f"Ab 2027 in der Produktgruppe „{s['pg_name']}“ veranschlagt."
    if len(sucs) == 1 and s["epl"] == o["epl"]:
        return f"Ab 2027 als „{s['produkt']}“ veranschlagt."
    return f"Ab 2027 {plans(sucs)} veranschlagt."

def export_details(out_dir, prod):
    """Write kostenarten.json and kennzahlen.json from data/epl_*.json (parse_epl.py)."""
    import glob

    data_dir = os.path.join(HERE, "..", "data")
    kosten, kennz, sources = [], [], []
    known = {e["epl"] for e in prod}

    def norm(code):
        # Page headers write "7.0" or "2"; the overview uses either form.
        for c in (code, code + ".0", code[:-2] if code.endswith(".0") else None):
            if c in known:
                return c
        return None

    for path in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(data_dir, "epl_*.json"))):
        with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
            band = json.load(f)
        for g in band["produktgruppen"]:
            epl = norm(g.get("epl") or "")
            if epl is None:
                print(f"{path}: Einzelplan {g.get('epl')!r} unbekannt, Produktgruppe {g['pg']} übersprungen")
                continue
            if epl not in sources:
                sources.append(epl)
            rows = g["ergebnisplan"]
            if not rows:
                continue
            base = {"epl": epl, "pg": g["pg"], "pg_name": g["name"], "produkt_id": ""}

            def row(pos, label, ebene, vals, **extra):
                kosten.append({**base, **extra, "pos": pos, "label": label, "ebene": ebene,
                               **{f"j{y}": v for y, v in zip(DETAIL_YEARS, vals)}})

            for pos, label, ebene in COST_ROWS:
                vals = rows.get(pos, [None] * 7)
                if any(vals):
                    row(pos, label, ebene, vals)
            # Allocation of the authority's internal services (Jahresergebnis 2).
            alloc_k = [sum((q.get("k2") or [None] * 7)[i] or 0 for q in g["produkte"]) for i in range(7)]
            alloc_e = [sum((q.get("e2") or [None] * 7)[i] or 0 for q in g["produkte"]) for i in range(7)]
            alloc_k[2] = alloc_e[2] = None  # The volume shows no allocation for 2026.
            if any(alloc_k):
                row("V", "Anteil an internen Dienstleistungen der Behörde", "haupt", alloc_k)
            erl = [(a or 0) + (b or 0) + (c or 0) if any(v is not None for v in (a, b, c)) else None
                   for a, b, c in zip(rows.get("1", [None] * 7), rows.get("8", [None] * 7), alloc_e)]
            row("E", "Erlöse", "erloese", erl)
            # Direct costs and allocated costs per product, matched to the product report.
            for q in g["produkte"]:
                hit = [p for p in prod if p["epl"] == epl and p["pg"] == g["pg"] and p["ipr"] == q["ipr"] and p["produkt"] == q["produkt"]]
                if len(hit) != 1:
                    continue
                pid = hit[0]["id"]
                row("P1", "Direkte Kosten", "produkt", q.get("k1") or [None] * 7, produkt_id=pid)
                if any(q.get("k2") or []):
                    k2 = list(q["k2"])
                    k2[2] = None
                    row("P2", "Anteil an internen Dienstleistungen der Behörde", "produkt", k2, produkt_id=pid)
            for k in g["kennzahlen"]:
                kennz.append({"epl": epl, "pg": g["pg"], "code": k["code"], "name": k["name"], "einheit": k["einheit"],
                              **{f"j{y}": k[y] for y in DETAIL_YEARS}})
    if not sources:
        return
    src = {"label": "Quelle", "value": "Haushaltsplan-Entwurf 2027/2028, Einzelplan-Bände " + ", ".join(sources) + " (PDF, Finanzbehörde Hamburg)"}
    write(out_dir, "kostenarten.json", kosten, [
        src, {"label": "Tabellen", "value": "Ergebnisplan der Produktgruppe; Kosten und Erlöse der Produktgruppe (Jahresergebnis 1 und 2)"},
        {"label": "Einheit", "value": "Tsd. EUR"},
        {"label": "Hinweis", "value": "jJJJJ = Wert des Jahres (2024 und 2025 Ist, 2026 fortgeschriebener Plan, 2027 und 2028 Plan, 2029 und 2030 Finanzplanung). Zeilen mit ebene 'davon' sind Teilmengen der Hauptzeile darüber. pos V = Kosten interner Dienstleistungen der Behörde, die im Jahresergebnis 2 auf die Produkte verteilt werden; für 2026 weist der Band keine Verteilung aus. pos E = Erlöse einschließlich Finanzergebnis und Verteilung. Zeilen P1 und P2 gelten für ein Produkt (produkt_id). Die Werte sind nicht um haushaltsinterne Verrechnungen bereinigt und liegen deshalb bis zu 1 % über dem Produktbericht."},
        code("parse_epl.py"), code("export_dashboard.py")])
    write(out_dir, "kennzahlen.json", kennz, [
        src, {"label": "Tabelle", "value": "Kennzahlen der Produktgruppe"},
        {"label": "Hinweis", "value": "jJJJJ = Wert des Jahres; einheit wie im Band (ANZ = Anzahl)."},
        code("parse_epl.py")])
